title: Case: A delivered household item is confirmed broken
context: The merchant has already reviewed its inline damage-inspection record. The next action is a replacement request to the party authorised to approve it.
initial_request: I would prefer the same lamp rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve a replacement.

events.body: DL-43266 rebooked for Friday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

Inline inspection record TG-8889: ceramic table lamp arrived with a separated base; recipient report reviewed against our returned-item inspection. Damage accepted for replacement assessment. Dispatch DL-1135 has completed; replacement approval is not yet recorded.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-477.txt
DL-22791 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

Thanks,
Yorick
--

acceptable_actions.summary: Request replacement authorisation from the merchant using the accepted damage evidence.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Emberlee Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Request replacement authorisation from the merchant using the accepted damage evidence. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Merchant approval and reserved stock do not establish replacement dispatch or receipt.
Treats label-scan-477.txt as evidence about DL-1135: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-33261)
Tells anyone that DL-1135 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-477.txt
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please approve a like-for-like lamp replacement for TG-8889 using your accepted inspection record. Oswin has selected replacement in the order thread.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-022: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-477.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-33261); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
